summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Piraeus Securities S.A. and Eurobank Equities Investment Firm S.A. as market makers for its common shares on Euronext Athens, effective June 2, 2026. The market-making agreement, for one year, involves simultaneous buy/sell orders for the company's own account at customary fixed fees, under Greek/EU regulations. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
